clue.text: She only partially gives us a nod

indicators.note: only partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A woman gives a half-hearted nod of agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name stands for any woman, so a pronoun for a female person fits it.

clue.text: Look over hilltops east

parts.note: the brow of a hill is its top, so hilltops are brows
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A walker surveys the summits lying to the east.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan casually through something, as in a shop or a book, is a synonym of looking over it.

clue.text: One who'll fill hollow first?

parts.note: a dent is a hollow made in a surface
first is written 1ST, with I standing for the numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone asks who will be first to fill a hole or gap.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue looks like a cryptic definition, but 'hollow first' also builds the answer piece by piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A tooth doctor fills cavities in teeth, so the professional is one who will do a filling.

clue.text: As result of pair singing, orchestra's beginning

parts.note: a duet is a piece sung by two people

indicators.note: beginning picks only the opening letter of the word orchestra

explanation.surface: A concert where two singers are followed by the orchestra starting up.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase meaning caused by is an everyday synonym of as a result of.

clue.text: Order starters from bistro — Italian diner

indicators.note: starters, like the first course of a meal, means the opening letters of the next three words

explanation.surface: A diner in an Italian bistro orders some first courses.
explanation.definitionFit: To command someone to do something is to bid them do it, an old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: So long after food you need water source

parts.note: fare means food, as in simple country fare
a well is a source of water drawn from the ground

explanation.surface: A traveller saying goodbye after a meal needs to find water.
explanation.definitionFit: So long is an informal way of saying goodbye, the same parting greeting.

clue.text: Fat, freckliest characters strangely those we'd like drawn?

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of the words before it are arranged in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Odd-looking fat, freckly people are those we would like to sketch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawn' suggests a portrait of the freckly figures; it means picked out in a lottery. 'characters' just says the letters are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Lottery stubs are pulled from a drum at a fete, and everyone hopes their own number comes out.

clue.text: Break up and plummet, holding defeat back

indicators.note: holding means the first word wraps round what follows

parts.note: to dive is to plunge or plummet downward

indicators.note: back says the word for defeat is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a loss is a defeat in a game

explanation.surface: A team on a losing streak collapses and splits apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break up' is used in its sense of formally ending a body, as a parliament is ended before an election.
explanation.definitionFit: When a partnership or parliament is formally ended it is broken up, a standard synonym.

clue.text: Article: Thursday evening's leader

indicators.note: leader picks out the first letter of the word evening

explanation.surface: A newspaper's editorial piece printed on Thursday evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Article' and 'leader' suggest journalism; here article is the grammatical kind.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar the definite article is this word, one of only two articles in English.

clue.text: Sick, going to doctor's practice

indicators.note: going to places the word for sick after the doctor

parts.note: DR is the usual abbreviation for doctor
ill means sick

explanation.surface: Someone unwell heads off to the GP's surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: A British doctor's 'practice' is a surgery, which fits the surface; here it means training by repetition.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeated exercise to learn a routine, as in a fire or army exercise, is a synonym of practice.

clue.text: Take it easy on the night before, to reach peak

indicators.note: in a charade on means one piece follows straight after the other

parts.note: the eve is the evening before an event
to rest is to take it easy

explanation.surface: A climber is told to relax the night before the summit push.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's highest mountain, in the Himalayas, is the ultimate example of a peak.

clue.text: Do it perhaps before leaving PC, and turn in hooligan

definitions.text: Do it perhaps before leaving PC

indicators.note: in says the word for turn sits inside the word for hooligan

parts.note: a lout is a rough, badly behaved youth
a go is a turn, as in it's your go

explanation.surface: Advice to shut down the computer properly and report a vandal to the police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn in' reads as 'hand over to police', but the two words do separate jobs: one gives a letter pair, the other places it.
explanation.definitionFit: Signing off a computer account is the routine step to take before walking away from it.

clue.text: Some Labour leader in Kremlin — their news agency covering it

indicators.note: covering means the agency's name wraps round the letter taken

parts.note: TASS is the Russian state news agency, the Kremlin's own

indicators.note: leader in picks the first letter of Kremlin

explanation.surface: Russian state media reports on a Labour politician visiting the Kremlin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' suggests the British political party; it is plain work.
explanation.definitionFit: Jobs of work or chores are units of labour, so a few of them are some labour.

clue.text: Facial hair that's unkempt is burden

indicators.note: unkempt means messy and untidy, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A man finds his scruffy whiskers a burden.
explanation.definitionFit: Strips of hair grown down the cheeks in front of the ears are a kind of facial hair.

clue.text: Every so often, spying old assembly of clergy

indicators.note: every so often picks letters at regular intervals, taking every other one

explanation.surface: Now and then someone spies an ancient gathering of churchmen.
explanation.definitionFit: A church council of bishops and clergy meeting to decide policy is this kind of body.

clue.text: Finalise moves securing large items for manicure

indicators.note: securing means the rearranged letters hold another letter inside
moves means the letters of finalise are shifted into a new order

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Someone finalising plans moves heavy equipment for a beauty salon.
explanation.definitionFit: Emery boards and metal rasps used to shape fingernails are tools of manicure.

clue.text: Republican Party upset staff

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a do is a party, as in a birthday do

explanation.surface: Republican Party workers are annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like employees; it is a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A long stick or pole carried in the hand is a staff, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Trick cyclist does little to hold hard position

indicators.note: to hold means the word for little wraps around the letter for hard

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
the lie of something is its position, as in the lie of the land

explanation.surface: A stunt rider balances in a difficult pose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trick cyclist' is British slang for a psychiatrist, but here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding on the back wheel with the front lifted is a stunt that bike tricksters perform.

clue.text: Scoffed when speaking out for school

indicators.note: when speaking out tells us the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: to scoff food is to eat it greedily, so scoffed means eaten

explanation.surface: Someone was mocked for voicing an opinion about a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scoffed' suggests mockery; in British slang it means gobbled food. ETON is a famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous public school near Windsor in England is an example of a school.

clue.text: Vendor keeping to railway timetable at first is a liar?

indicators.note: keeping means the word for vendor holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a seller is a vendor

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of timetable

explanation.surface: A ticket seller who claims the trains run to timetable must be lying.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tells tall tales or fibs is a gentle name for a liar, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Most villainous of the French, blocking gate

indicators.note: blocking says the French word sits in the way inside the word for gate

parts.note: a wicket is a small gate or door
des is French for of the, plural

explanation.surface: The worst French villains barricade a gateway.
explanation.definitionFit: Most evil and depraved is the superlative sense of wicked, matching most villainous.

clue.text: Like champion so raised, I'm very resilient in heat!

parts.note: as means like, in the sense of in the manner of
the best is the champion, the top performer

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word so is turned to read upwards

explanation.surface: A boastful winner claims to cope with any pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resilient in heat' sounds like a sporting champion under pressure; it is a fireproof material speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: The fibrous mineral was valued as a fireproof material, so it says it withstands heat.

clue.text: Before Grand Final I unexpectedly defect

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged letters ahead of the letter for grand
unexpectedly says the letters of final and I come out in a surprising new order

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A player switches sides just before a Grand Final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'defect' looks like a verb meaning switch sides; it is a noun meaning a flaw.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortcoming or weakness in someone's character is a flaw, the same as a defect.

clue.text: Hair mat removed from bedding

indicators.note: removed from says the word mat is taken out of the bedding word

parts.note: a mattress is bedding to lie on

explanation.surface: Matted hair is taken off the bed linen.
explanation.definitionFit: A long lock of a person's hair is a word mostly found in poetry and crosswords.

clue.text: Behold Princess lifting graven image

indicators.note: lifting in a down clue means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: lo is an old word for look or behold
DI refers to Diana, Princess of Wales

explanation.surface: Look, a princess is raising a carved statue.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved figure worshipped as a god is the biblical sense of a graven image.

clue.text: Boy or girl, deafening without end

indicators.note: without end means the final letter is dropped from the word for deafening

parts.note: something deafening is very loud

explanation.surface: A child making a ceaseless deafening noise.
explanation.definitionFit: The short name serves both sexes, for Louis or Louise, so it is a name for either.
